title: 04章、时代抉择洗礼启
content_zh:
看着边关月淡然的模样，张荼的面色变得阴晴不定，当然，也是下意识地觉得，眼前这宛如谪仙的男子，不是自己的圈子可以遇到的，就算是有所交集，也没有这闲工夫与自己逗弄。

    再说了……被算计，自己配么？

    张荼嘴角划起一道自嘲的笑容，学着边关月的模样，施施然行了一礼，然后说道：“还请先生解惑。”

    边关月摇曳着折扇，悠然说道：“既然你已经诚心诚意地发问了，那么我也只好大发慈悲地告诉你，你们口中的地球，经历了太多文明起落，星河都曾永寂，但地球永存，这里，烙印着宇宙中最初的法与理。”

    “你们眼中的地球，是这片宇宙的起始，可笑的你们竟然还孜孜不倦地探寻着外面的文明，在我看来，这和开门揖盗没有什么区别，地外文明，都是叛逆。而这里，是这片天地，最后的正统。”

    边关月的话语，如同一道炸雷一般在张荼的脑海之中响起，脑海之中记忆纷纷，不断的回想起这三十年间，所见到的各种脑洞大开的测想。

    “母星至高论”竟然是对的，一时间张荼心中百味杂陈，那种祖上曾阔过的复杂心情，外人又如何明白呢。

    边关月继续说道：“而我，则是来自最近的一个文明时代，曾有人批命，将我那个时代称之为八荒时代，而你们这个时代，又被称之为九星时代。”

    边关月的声音开始变得落寞起来，似是无尽的眷恋和思念：“那个时期的九州，洪荒大地之上，瘴疠丛生遍布妖邪，抛弃至高神性的仙魔厮杀不止，其中战败魔神朽烂的残躯，将憎恨和怨怒散布尘世，化为了各种妖邪，每当妖邪躁动不安，瘟疫、鬼怪、异变就会随之而来，但也正是因为妖邪乃是魔神的神念所化，人们在击败妖邪的同时，也窥视到了仙神强大的起源。”

    “于是，再后来，人族便有了自己的进化之路，最初的一批至强者们，他们向众生立下誓言，为守护而杀生，除灭诸多苦厄，造就盛世太平，如是经年……”

    言语之间，边关月似是回到了那个峥嵘而热血的年代。

    那个时代，牺牲和奉献是回响在天地之间的主旋律。

    那些人，都曾是他并肩作战的兄弟。

    可惜，天道有缺，那些惊才绝艳的人儿，大多永远地消散了，就连这最后的传承之地，也是有莫名人物在背后推动才得以保存，不过他不明白的是，这种惊天人物为何还会忌讳莫深呢，为何从不肯出手庇护九州呢？

    边关月的声音愈加沧桑而低沉，其中有着难以释怀的郁结：“如是经年……在漫长的血战之中，他们也难免被业障所困，被魔神遗恨所污染，或陷于恐惧而疯狂、跪伏；或自相残杀而死，或者走火入魔而道消于天地间。”

    “当时，九州大地之上，有着五位最强大的先驱者，两位死于血战之中，一位不知所踪，还有一位……被策反，抛弃了最初的誓言。历经近万年劫难，唯有一位天策上将还尚存尘世，那个时代，是人族积弱的时代，而你眼前的场景，便是当初最后一位天策上将的征战遗址，这里，也是那个时代，在这方天地中最后的印记。”

    乐意听这边关月的诉说，目中露出了向往和憧憬。

    那个年代，海一般的兵器与铠甲在舞动着，手中的武器在烈日下灼灼发亮，首领与战士齐齐狂呼，陶醉入神，如痴如醉。

    那是一个骄傲与血腥并存的年代，纵然积弱，但是人族依旧有强盛如狮的虎狼之势，那是铁与血的最强汇集，那是暴力与男儿的世界！

    或许，每一个齐国的男人内心深处，都蔓延着自远古传承而来的野心基因，渴望建功立业，开疆拓土，滚滚热血在奔流着，张荼一瞬间感觉自己那沉寂的热血，似是在这一瞬间被激活，被唤醒。

    话说到这里，边关月摊摊手，脸上挂着似笑非笑的悲伤表情，说道：“我只能告诉你这么多了，还有……不要憧憬那个年代，英雄辈出的时代，是民族崛起的时代，注定了是一曲悲歌，当然，时代不同，英雄的定义也是不同的。就像你们这个时代，可以挥洒才智和理想，却是不用付出太过惨痛的代价。”
content_en:
Looking at Bian Guanyue's indifferent expression, Zhang Tu's expression became gloomy. Of course, he also subconsciously felt that the man in front of him, who looked like an immortal, was not someone he could meet in his circle. Even if they met, he wouldn't have the time to tease him.

    Besides... Do I deserve to be plotted against?

    A self-deprecating smile appeared at the corner of Zhang Tu's mouth. Following Bian Guanyue's example, Shi Shiran saluted, and then said, "Sir, please clarify my doubts."

    Bian Guanyue swayed her folding fan and said leisurely: "Since you have asked your question sincerely, I have no choice but to tell you with compassion. The earth you talk about has experienced the ups and downs of too many civilizations. The stars and rivers have been eternally silent, but the earth will always exist. Here, the original laws and principles in the universe are imprinted."

    "The earth in your eyes is the beginning of this universe. It's ridiculous that you are still tirelessly exploring the civilizations outside. In my opinion, this is no different from opening the door to robbers. Extraterrestrial civilizations are all rebellion. And this is the last orthodoxy of this world."

    Bian Guanyue's words sounded like a thunder in Zhang Tu's mind. Memories flooded his mind, constantly recalling the various imaginative speculations he had seen in the past thirty years.

    "The theory of the mother star being supreme" turned out to be right. Zhang Tu's heart was full of mixed emotions for a while. How could outsiders understand the complicated emotions that his ancestors had experienced before.

    Bian Guanyue continued: "And I come from the most recent civilization era. Someone once ordered that my era be called the Eight Desolations Era, and your era is also called the Nine Stars Era."

    Bian Guanyue's voice began to become lonely, and seemed to be filled with endless nostalgia and longing: "In the Kyushu of that period, on the ancient land, miasma was overrun by demons and evil spirits. The immortals and demons who had abandoned their supreme divinity were fighting endlessly. Among them, the decayed remains of the defeated demon gods were transformed into hatred and evil spirits. Resentment spreads in the world and turns into various evil spirits. Whenever the evil spirits become restless, plagues, ghosts, and mutations will follow. But it is precisely because the evil spirits are transformed by the divine thoughts of the demon gods. When people defeat the evil spirits, they also get a glimpse of the powerful origin of the immortal gods. "

    "So, later on, the human race had its own path of evolution. The first batch of the strongest people made an oath to all living beings, killed for protection, eliminated many miseries, and created a prosperous and peaceful world. This goes on for many years..."

    Between words, Bian Guanyue seemed to have returned to that prosperous and passionate era.

    In that era, sacrifice and dedication were the main themes that echoed between heaven and earth.

    Those people were all his brothers who fought alongside him.

    It's a pity that the way of heaven is lacking, and most of those amazing and talented people have disappeared forever. Even this last place of inheritance is preserved because of the help of unknown people behind it. But what he doesn't understand is why such amazing people are so taboo, and why they never want to protect Kyushu?

    Bian Guanyue's voice became more and more vicissitudes of life, with an unforgettable frustration in it: "As the years go by...in the long bloody battle, they will inevitably be trapped by their karma, polluted by the demon's hatred, or fall into fear and go crazy, kneeling down; or kill each other and die, or become possessed and disappear between heaven and earth."

    "At that time, there were five most powerful pioneers on the land of Kyushu. Two died in a bloody battle, one disappeared, and one... was instigated to rebel and abandoned his original oath. After nearly ten thousand years of catastrophe, only one Tiance Admiral is still alive. That era was an era when the human race was weak, and the scene in front of you is the battle site of the last Tiance Admiral. This is also the last mark of that era in this world."

    I am willing to listen to Guan Yue's words here, with yearning and longing in her eyes.

    At that time, a sea of ​​weapons and armors were dancing, the weapons in their hands were shining brightly under the scorching sun, and the leaders and soldiers were shouting in unison, intoxicated and mesmerized.

    It was an era when pride and blood coexisted. Even though they were weak, the human race still had the power of tigers and wolves as strong as lions. It was the strongest collection of iron and blood, and it was a world of violence and men!

    Perhaps, deep down in the heart of every man in the Qi Kingdom, there is the gene of ambition inherited from ancient times, the desire to make contributions and expand the territory, with hot blood flowing. Zhang Tu felt that his dormant blood seemed to be activated and awakened at this moment.

    At this point, Bian Guanyue spread his hands, with a sad expression on his face, and said: "I can only tell you this much, and... don't look forward to that era. The era when heroes emerged in large numbers is the era of the rise of the nation. It is destined to be a tragic song. Of course, the era is different, and the definition of a hero is also different. Just like your era, you can use your talents and ideals, but you don't have to pay a heavy price."
title_en: Chapter 04, The baptism of choice of the times begins
